note.zh: 在隔离测评工作区中，通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（Low）使用仓库标准中文提示词一次生成，源码未经人工修改，耗时 2 分 18 秒。原生系统提示正常启用，工作区未注入 AGENTS.md、额外上下文文件、外部 Skill、插件或 MCP，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断。AntiGravity 未提供可验证的内置 Skill 与上下文发现总开关，因此隔离状态如实记录为 partial；CLI 也未回报运行时模型 ID，归因依据为已选择的精确目录项。交付修复：原始 HTML 运行时请求 CDN 上的 Three.js 0.128.0，会被展示沙箱阻止；本页仅内联该精确版本依赖，未修改游戏逻辑，原始归档与远端对象均已保留，并通过审计 repair-artifact 路径发布。
note.en: Generated one-shot from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt in an isolated benchmark workspace using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (Low), with unmodified source, in 2 minutes 18 seconds. The native system prompt remained enabled, no AGENTS.md, extra context files, external skills, plugins, or MCP were injected, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. AntiGravity exposes no verifiable master switch for bundled skills or context discovery, so isolation is truthfully recorded as partial; the CLI also did not report a runtime model ID, and attribution is based on the exact selected catalog entry. Delivery repair: the original HTML requested Three.js 0.128.0 from a runtime CDN blocked by the display sandbox; this page only inlines that exact dependency, changes no game logic, preserves the original archive and remote object, and was published through the audited repair-artifact path.
